nodes.description: Storage slot keccak256('PROXIABLE') = 0xc5f16f0fcc639fa48a6947836d9850f504798523bf8c9a3a87d5876cf622bcf7 holding the implementation/logic contract address used by the proxy.

Constructor(bytes constructData, address contractLogic) that writes contractLogic into the PROXIABLE slot with assembly sstore and then delegatecalls constructData on contractLogic, requiring success.
External payable fallback() that loads the logic address from the PROXIABLE slot and forwards all calldata via raw assembly delegatecall, reverting or returning the raw returndata.
Bytes memory constructor parameter containing the initialization calldata that is forwarded to the logic contract through delegatecall.
Address constructor parameter naming the logic/implementation contract; it is both stored as logicAddress and used as the delegatecall target.
Boolean local holding the success flag returned by the constructor delegatecall, later used in require(success, "Construction failed").
Unnamed bytes memory local ('__') capturing the returndata of the constructor delegatecall; it is never used.
Assembly sstore writing contractLogic to the fixed PROXIABLE slot 0xc5f16f0fcc639fa48a6947836d9850f504798523bf8c9a3a87d5876cf622bcf7, bypassing Solidity storage layout checks.
Raw delegatecall performed in the constructor to contractLogic with attacker-supplied constructData, executing untrusted code in the context of the proxy and its storage.
Unchecked assembly delegatecall in the fallback that forwards msg.data (calldatacopy) to the logic address loaded from storage, giving arbitrary external code full control of proxy storage.

edges.reason: The constructor executes the assembly sstore that persists contractLogic into the PROXIABLE slot.
The contractLogic parameter value is the data written by the sstore into the logic address slot.
The contractLogic parameter is used as the delegatecall target in the constructor.
The constructData parameter is the calldata passed to the constructor delegatecall.
The constructor performs the delegatecall to the logic contract to initialize state.
The success flag of the constructor delegatecall is returned into the success local variable.
The returndata of the constructor delegatecall is captured into the unused bytes local.
contractLogic is persisted into the logicAddress state variable slot.
The fallback sloads the logic address from storage and uses it as the delegatecall target, letting untrusted implementation code re-enter the proxy with full storage control.
The fallback performs the raw delegatecall forwarding all calldata to the logic contract, an external call to untrusted code that can recursively invoke the fallback.

normalization_plan.reason: constructData is a constructor parameter whose only use is as the calldata of the delegatecall_constructor unsafe operation.
contractLogic is a constructor parameter used directly as the target of delegatecall_constructor and as the value written into the logicAddress slot.
success is a local that only carries the boolean result of the delegatecall_constructor for the require check.
The unused bytes local only holds the returndata of delegatecall_constructor and has no other effect.
